records.item: General completion and correction / Smash Room 3 door / fan-switch issue

clauses.quote: any portion of the Work not in conformance to the requirements of the Contract Documents.
provide all necessary construction supervision, inspection, construction equipment, construction labor, materials, tools, and subcontracted items.
Design-Builder shall promptly correct the Defective Work at its own cost and time
Design-Builder shall maintain the Schedule of Work.
Design-Builder shall be responsible for the management of Subcontractors in the performance of their work.

records.application: Request a dated correction/completion schedule from Carney and identify the approved drawing / accepted punch item supporting each. Carney manages its subcontractors. An unfinished included door is completion work. A wrongly installed switch is correction if it departs from approved drawings/agreed scope.
records.limitations: This review does not independently establish that current physical installations violate code, nor that an owner-requested relocation is original scope. Later approved plans and COs control where applicable.

clauses.section: A-01.1 Door Schedule and hardware sets
clauses.quote: HARDWARE SET #1 ... 1 PRIVACY LOCKSET; HARDWARE SET #2 ... 1 PASSAGE SET
clauses.transcription_note: Ellipses separate schedule fields; not continuous quotation.

records.finding: Small Paint doors 112 and 113 use hardware set 1 (privacy lockset). Large Paint door 105 and existing storage door 107E use hardware set 2 (passage set). Visually confirmed on p31.
records.application: Ask Carney to reconcile the specific door numbers against the current approved schedule and its punch-list commitments before classifying passage-hardware replacement as included correction or added work.
records.limitations: The presence of a lock on a Small Paint door does not by itself establish departure from this original contractual schedule; later plan revisions, code requirements and written commitments may alter the analysis. Do not claim a code violation from a description alone.

clauses.quote: adjusting and balancing of systems and equipment for readiness.
A REPORT OF THESE MEASUREMENTS, INDICATING ANY AND ALL DEFICIENCIES SHALL BE SUBMITTED FOR OWNER REVIEW.
PRIOR TO FINAL INSPECTION OF THE WORK, THE TAB SPECIALIST SHALL BALANCE ALL SYSTEMS AS INDICATED ABOVE TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF THE DESIGN.
RANDOM TESTS WITHIN 90 DAYS OF COMPLETING TAB TO VERIFY BALANCE CONDITIONS AND SEASONAL TESTS.
PERFORM A COMPLETE TEST AND BALANCE OF ALL EQUIPMENT. PROVIDE A WRITTEN REPORT TO THE ARCHITECT.

records.application: Written request for heating-season diagnosis, distribution / damper / thermostat / airflow checks, balancing to design requirements and a written report is well grounded. A cooling-only test does not itself resolve a reported heating distribution problem. Request all serving units identified consistently by plan tag, model and serial number.
records.limitations: Exhibit B expressly limits retained RTU scope. Do not equate uneven rooms with an automatic obligation to replace old units. M-0.2 tolerance is ±5%; M-1.0 note N uses ±10%; have design professional reconcile the actual applicable criteria rather than silently select one.

records.application: These are express handover duties. Request the actual applicable warranty documents, manuals, test / inspection approvals, record drawings and operating instruction; paid invoices and lien waivers do not substitute for them.

records.item: Substantial Completion certificate and warranty dates

clauses.quote: This date shall be confirmed by a certificate of Substantial Completion signed by The Parties.
Warranties shall commence on and extend for one (1) year after the date of Substantial Completion of the Work or of a designated portion.
With respect to any portion of Work first performed after Substantial Completion, the one-year correction period shall commence when that portion of Work is complete.
Correction periods shall not be extended by corrective work performed by Design-Builder.

records.application: Request a jointly signed certificate stating the actual SC date, written warranty start/end dates and identification of any portions first completed later. Do not conflate final payment with the warranty start date.
records.limitations: Substantial Completion does not necessarily require every punch item done. The definition also excuses CO as prerequisite when beyond Carney control. Specific drawing warranties use different start-date phrases; section14.2 provides priority rules. Do not assume missing certificate means no warranty clock has begun.

clauses.quote: THE COVER OF THE INSTRUCTION BOOKLET SHALL BEAR THE NAME, ADDRESS AND PHONE NUMBER OF THE PROJECT, ARCHITECT, ENGINEER, MECHANICAL CONTRACTOR AND SUBCONTRACTORS.
Design-Builder shall be responsible for the management of Subcontractors in the performance of their work.

records.application: Mechanical contractor/subcontractor contact details have express support in the drawing manual requirement. Ask Carney to identify who coordinates service and warranty requests.
records.limitations: A named individual, emergency escalation route, response-time SLA or bank-specific closeout workflow was not found expressly required in these reviewed clauses. These can be practical requested arrangements; do not invent contract duties.

records.item: Written notice and opportunity to correct

clauses.quote: Owner shall give prompt written notice to Design-Builder.
Owner shall promptly notify Design-Builder in writing.

records.application: Keep current issues in the dated written punch-list notice and offer access for inspection/testing/correction.
records.limitations: Section3.9.1 expressly addresses waiver if owner fails promptly to notify or provide reasonable opportunity to test/correct within the one-year period. Section3.9.3 substitute correction before finalpayment refers to Owner right-to-carry-out procedures; not automatic authority to hire others and deduct without following required process.
